922.s: Description of the father's height and build; he turned gray after returning from Chicago in 1917.

800.t: His father: trumpet to alto to baritone, and his death
800.s: His father played trumpet, then alto and baritone, with the Onward and Tuxedo bands, and died at 57 when Alexander's son was a few months old.
800.q: My father used to play trumpet. He used to play trumpet. But after a while, he stopped playing trumpet. The way he was working, he broke his seat. He stopped playing trumpet, he started playing alto. Then he started playing baritone. He started playing baritone.

841.t: Whether Harris played with Dawson; his father's death in 1930
841.s: Harris never played with old man Dawson; his father died in 1930 aged about 46.

142.s: Bebo came to New York and wanted to see his son; Chucho was afraid of contact with exiles, and Paquito carried messages for their brief meeting.
142.q: My mother call me. Chucho was very afraid—in those days, not any more now—in those days contact with people for the exiled people, some of them they don’t like it.
